def.registered: Distinct youth profiles registered within the selected scope and registration period.
def.active: Distinct registered youth with at least one learning activity in the last 30 days, as of the displayed snapshot date.
def.completion: Completed course enrolments divided by course enrolments in the selected cohort or enrolment period. Counted as enrolments, not unique people.
def.guidance: Distinct graduates receiving a recorded guidance interaction divided by distinct graduates. Assessment completion alone is counted separately.
def.internships: Distinct confirmed internship placement records. The unique-youth count is shown separately.
def.jobs: Distinct confirmed job-start records. Excludes offers that were not accepted and freelance selection.
def.uniquePlaced: Young people with a confirmed job start or internship, deduplicated: job starts plus internships minus youth with both. Freelance and enterprise outcomes are not included.
def.windows: Confirmed employed graduates divided by all graduates eligible for that follow-up window. Response coverage and unknown status are shown separately.
def.daysToJob: Mean calendar days from graduation to first confirmed job start for placed graduates with both dates.
def.retention: Participants confirmed still in the placed role at the specified interval divided by placements eligible for that interval. Unknowns are shown separately.
def.freelance: Assignments selected, assignments completed, unique earners and repeat clients are separate measures. Fees are shown only if the sample data supports them.
def.enterprise: Business concepts completed, customer tests, support-programme acceptances and first reported sales. These are not counted as employment placements.
def.places: Fictional cohort sizes from the brief: K01 has 24 places, K02 18 and K03 20. The named learners are a subset.
def.learners: Named demonstration learner records in scope, including applicants, cohort members and graduates.
def.currentActive: Named learners with a course in progress or an attended session in the demonstration records.
def.attendance: Present marks divided by all attendance marks recorded by trainers for sessions in scope.
def.practicals: Practical tasks submitted by learners and not yet graded by their trainer.
